verdict.rationale: Anytype ships an official MCP server and an open-source agents skill so that external AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot) can read, search and modify Objects through natural language. However, natural-language operation depends on a third-party AI client rather than a built-in command interface. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command interface, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation quality, documentation of which operations are reliably drivable by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Anytype MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI assistants to seamlessly interact with Anytype's API through natural language.
an open-source toolkit that gives AI assistants a safe way to read, search, and modify Objects in your Anytype Channels
Drop it into Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, or any other agent-capable tool, and the agent can run scripts against your Anytype data
